name: Umbral Knight
description: A fallen knight of the Order of the Umbral Hand that channels tainted magic using their essence rather than a conduit. These knights typically command lesser minions of the order and are unyielding in their attacks, preferring death rather than surrender.

actions.name: Bastard Sword
actions.description: The umbral knight swings at a creature with it's bastard sword, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Pommel Strike
actions.description: The umbral knight strikes out with their pommel, not dealing damage but causing their target's next defense check before the start of their next turn to have a 1d4 penalty.

actions.name: Rally
actions.description: Once per day, the umbral knight calls out to any allies within 8 units that can hear them and rally their spirits, giving them 1d6+1 temporary health.

actions.name: Command
actions.description: The umbral knight commands an ally within 6 units to use an action. If this action is an attack check, that check gains a 1d4 bonus.

actions.name: No Quarter
actions.description: The next Bastard Sword action that the umbral knight uses before the end of it's turn makes 3 attacks instead of 1. Each swing has a 1d4 attack penalty and cannot benefit from a true hit.  If all 3 attacks deal damage, the target gains the wounded condition. If 2 attacks deal damage, the target gains the bleeding condition. Otherwise, the umbral knight gains a tier of exhaustion.

actions.name: Attack of Opportunity
actions.description: In response to a creature leaving their area of control, the umbral knight uses the Bastard Sword action against the target.

traits.name: Tainted Magic
traits.description: The umbral knight does not need a conduit to channel magic and instead pulls their power from a tainted source. All spells that deal divine damage are converted to dark damage instead. When the umbral knight rolls a 1 on  a spell attack, they die and spawn 1d4 umbral shamblers in unoccupied adjacent tiles.
